claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellTargetRestriction.sensor_visible_within_feet
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item-granted Detect Thoughts cast is not using the spell's normal origin/range. It can target creatures seen within a fixed distance of the active Scrying sensor, so the grant needs a way to override targeting from the granted spell's own header to sensor-relative targeting.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.durationOverride.nonconcentration_linked_to_named_spell_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item changes how the granted Detect Thoughts persists: it explicitly removes concentration and ties the spell's end condition to the item's Scrying cast. Existing grant_spell_access can override DC and a narrow target restriction, but it cannot override concentration or express that one granted spell ends when another granted spell ends.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends."
